# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# dbt runner dependencies — the FULL transitive closure, pinned exactly.
#
# Generated by resolving `dbt-postgres==1.9.0` inside the digest-pinned base
# image and freezing the result:
#
#   docker run --rm --entrypoint sh \
#     python:3.12-slim@sha256:09f7da3bc104798d0afb40bc08d23ab2da20a76130cec1f2ef170848f5d85217 \
#     -c "pip install -q 'dbt-postgres==1.9.0' && pip freeze"
#
# The whole closure is listed rather than just the top-level requirement, so
# two builds a month apart install byte-identical packages. A bare
# `dbt-postgres==1.9.0` would silently pull a new transitive dependency the day
# one is released, which is how a "no code changed" build starts failing.
#
# NOT hash-pinned. `pip-compile --generate-hashes` did not complete against
# this base image in a reasonable time, so what is actually in place is the
# exact-version closure plus the digest-pinned base, not artefact hashes.
# Stated here rather than implied: a reviewer is entitled to know which of the
# two controls is present and which is not.
#
# REGENERATE by re-running the command above and pasting the output verbatim.
# Do not hand-edit a version: the list is a resolver's output, and an invented
# pin fails the build with "No matching distribution found" at best.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
